method: Static x86 scan of non-thunk references to WGSERVER IAT slots, combined with proven direct import-thunk callsites. Classification proves reference form only, not host implementation semantics.
closed_boundaries: Distinguishes directly called host functions from host imports consumed through IAT data/indirect-reference paths.
Identifies imports present in the PE table with no static code reference in the supplied module, preventing false claims that every import is executed.
Maintains WCC and WBB evidence independently and hash-bound.
limitations: A non-thunk IAT reference may be a data import, address load, or indirect callable pointer; exact type requires symbols, host binary, or dynamic tracing.
No-static-reference imports may be used by loader initialization, exception metadata, runtime-generated code, or unreachable/dead code.
